name: Dataverse metadata-only provisioning
trigger_boundary: DEV metadata-only schema or seed package
use_when: Dataverse table seed or solution metadata must be prepared without secrets
do_not_use_when: PROD TEST Default or regulated payloads are in scope

name: Connection registry dedup
use_when: Connection records need dedup before Dataverse seed
do_not_use_when: raw secrets or live connector writes are requested

name: Power Automate Work Queue binding
trigger_boundary: Dataverse rows need Work Queue routing
use_when: Work Queue metadata or pilot items are prepared
do_not_use_when: flow activation or production automation is requested

name: OpenAI metadata-only classification
trigger_boundary: Advisory OpenAI classification with synthetic metadata
use_when: Structured metadata enrichment is useful and key/cost gate is approved
do_not_use_when: raw paths docs PII secrets or canon decision are required

name: GitHub grouped versioning
trigger_boundary: Large local package must become reviewable PR
use_when: Multiple lanes need grouped commits and checks
do_not_use_when: merge is not authorized or file has no lane

name: Postmerge evidence canonization
trigger_boundary: Merge happened and local evidence must be versioned
use_when: Preflight postcheck readback or rollback evidence needs a PR

name: DEV runtime controlled activation
trigger_boundary: One exact DEV runtime action is authorized
use_when: One flow and one item can prove runtime behavior
do_not_use_when: Target flow or item is ambiguous

name: Secret-safe API key handling
trigger_boundary: API key exists or must be created/reused
use_when: A live API smoke needs a key but no secret can be printed
do_not_use_when: Repo persistence or prompt logging is requested

name: Change-aware governance validation
trigger_boundary: CI or local gate must prioritize without reducing coverage
use_when: A PR needs fast feedback and full assurance

name: Agent retrospective learning
trigger_boundary: A completed frontier must become reusable learning
use_when: A chain of PRs produced repeatable patterns

name: Dataverse Work Queue backreference mapping
trigger_boundary: Processed Work Queue item needs traceability
use_when: Target row mapping is exact or mapping record is safe
do_not_use_when: Target candidate count is not exactly 1 and target update is requested

name: No inference runtime write guard
use_when: Any live or metadata write could be inferred from partial evidence
do_not_use_when: Exact target identity is present and validated
